name: ceramics-webapp
description: React single-page storefront for the single-seller ceramics store. Serves the public catalog and product pages to anonymous visitors, the cart and checkout flow (sign-in required) to Shoppers, and the catalog and order-management views (sign-in required) to the Store Owner. Holds no business logic or secrets — all data and payment/email side effects go through ceramics-api.

dependencies.name: ceramics-api
dependencies.description: REST API for the catalog, cart, checkout, and order history/management.

dependencies.name: user-auth
dependencies.description: Thunder SSO — signs a Shopper in before checkout and a Store Owner in before catalog/order management; public browsing needs no sign-in.
